description: BALTRAD exchanges weather radar observations between participating nodes and processes them with shared algorithms. The Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute and BALTRAD partners publish components for data exchange, storage, scheduling, quality control and radar products. The current GitHub organisation includes RAVE, BaltradDex, the database, beam-blockage tools and other documented modules. Spatial coverage and update frequency follow the contributing radar network. The resulting observations can support precipitation forcing and hazard checks for flood and transport simulations. Public code is free: the suite documentation states LGPL version 3 or later, while individual components retain their own GPL or LGPL terms. Related Py-ART users can exchange or compare radar products, without implying identical processing. A limitation is that deployment needs several configured services and appropriate data-sharing arrangements. The former provider host was unavailable, but current documentation and source metadata were read. The archived 2017 snapshot has separate CC-BY-4.0 metadata. No radar observations or software archive were downloaded.
